_comment: Intentional deltas for the Board P 20 V / 5 A revision (decisions.json dec-p-20v-revision and dec-p-20v-front-end-r2; user decision card 2026-10-31 D3-A + D5-1). r2 adds the Q3 reverse-blocking FET and Q4 B_GATE pulldown, sets UVLO to 11.5k/4.02k and drops C4.
